chunks: And it is narrated from Ḥanān ibn Sadīr, who said:
A man asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about lost property while I was listening.
So he said: "Announce it for one year. Then if you find its owner, otherwise you are more entitled to it."

key_terms.أَحَقُّ بِهَا: more entitled to possess it after the required process
key_terms.اللُّقَطَةِ: lost property that has been found
key_terms.تُعَرِّفُهَا: announce it publicly so its owner may be identified
key_terms.سَنَةً: a period of one full year

ai.seo_question: What should a person do with found property in Shi'a hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on luqaṭah, or found property. The finder must announce it for one year in search of the owner; if the owner is not found after that, the finder has a stronger claim to keep it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4058 - It is narrated from Hanan ibn Sadir, who said:

A man asked Abu Abdullah (as) about lost property while I was listening.
Imam (as) said:
"Announce it for one year. If you find its owner, return it to him; otherwise, you are more entitled to keep it."
